title: A shared majority-agreement coordinate
statement: Let $d$ be an odd positive integer with $d\le n$, and let $x,y\in\{\pm1\}^n$. Among their first $d$ coordinates, there is a coordinate at which both strings agree with the majority of their respective first-$d$-coordinate strings.
